name: agentlane
description: Each agent session gets its own running copy of the project, mobile app or web app: look and screenshot on the simulator, emulator or browser it claimed, run on its device, and skills for setting a project up, driving the app and keeping a project's run skill true. agentlane init in the project adds the hooks that keep simctl, adb, playwright-cli and agent-browser off the devices and browsers other sessions hold.
